name: Slippery Skin

card.plain: Slick kappa skin slips any throw that catches you while the move starts up.

notes: A move property the engine reads for throws (properties.throw_break, AM12 / YOK-172): a throw that would grab the carrier during the move's startup is broken automatically, a clash with no damage like throw vs throw. Not throw-invulnerability, so E17 ('throws ignore throw-invulnerability data') stands. Data only, no new animation (A10); visual is a preset reference for clip-matcher. Wording from the rules.md modifiers table.
